Cadence/staleness thresholds are NOT declared here — they live in warroom/cadence-registry.json, owned by WARROOM-FRESHNESS-001/READPLANE-001; join key is source_id. Tab list (11) is warroom/cadence-registry.json's `tabs` object, Shiv-ruled 2026-08-26 — used as the authoritative denominator per WARROOM-INVENTORY-001's role in this card (that card's own file was not found on disk this pass; the cadence registry's tabs list is the closest ruled, on-disk authority and is cited as such, not silently swapped in as INVENTORY-001's output).
_owner_script_root: ~/SaSMaster (every owner_script below is relative to that repo and was confirmed to exist on disk this pass — see docs/WARROOM_DAILY_REFRESH.md Phase 0/1 findings). No owner_script listed here was created by this card (C6).
_gap_policy: A tab with no producing job on disk gets refresh_job_id:null and a written gap_reason — never an invented job (Phase 1 instruction). generate-status.js is a special case: it exists and runs on cron, but WARROOM-FRESHNESS-001's own cadence-registry.json documents it as NOT wired to sasmaster.ops.run_log (cadence_status: derived-from-cron-but-unverifiable-freshness). Because it is unwired, as_of(tab_id) for any tab whose only source is generate-status.js resolves to the honest C2 state N/A — never refreshed (no run_log row exists to query), not an invented timestamp and not a second gap category invented by this card.
generated_at_note: Static registry file, not a generated report — see docs/REFRESH_CALENDAR.md for the rendered-from-this-file calendar view.
